title: Silas and the Vow
author: Hazel Halloran
blurb: Wendell Fairweather, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
